title: 第14章 丧尸病毒治疗药剂！击杀精英丧尸！
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

前往花苑小区的道路，罗兰这几天一直都在清理。

此刻这条道路上的丧尸明显和别处少了许多。

罗兰一身轻装，只带了刀和两把枪，身上穿着皮甲，头上带着泳镜，但是泳镜并没有佩戴在眼睛上。

他一路潜行，尽量不惊动周围的丧尸。

就算有丧尸发现了罗兰，也很快就被罗兰处理掉，没有引来更多的丧尸。

大约到了中午，罗兰这才走完了这一公里的路，来到了花园小区大门附近。

“果然，玲玲没有骗我。”

罗兰看着花园小区的大门，心中暗暗点头。

只见小区大门外，有许多战斗后留下的痕迹，还有一辆装甲车，不过此刻这辆装甲车上，到处都是凹陷和划痕，显得残破不堪。

“东西，就在里面！”

罗兰凝视着装甲车，旋即仔细观察周围。

装甲车周围，一些丧尸正在游荡，地上还有许多丧尸的尸体，显然是先前战斗留下的。

甚至，还有一些一看就不是普通丧尸的精英丧尸！

“如果这些丧尸脑子里都有晶核......”

罗兰心中一热，随即他便压下想要立刻去开盲盒的冲动，目光警惕的看着周围。

“没有发现异常，或许，那头丧尸不在这里，又或者被击杀了。”

观察了半天，罗兰双眼一凝：“速战速决！”

他将长刀放在背后，一把枪挂在腰带上，双手持枪，顿时爆发全速冲向了装甲车。

虽然看上去没有什么危险，但是这里毕竟发生过高强度的战斗，为了能安全得到可以解除丧尸病毒的药剂，罗兰自然不会有所保留！

以他现在的实力，手里拿着自动步枪，完全能碾压没有拿着自动步枪的他！

只见罗兰速度飞快，十几步过去，便冲到了装甲车身旁。

装甲车的车门是钻了进去。

里面没有丧尸，只有尸体。

而在一个被半。

“就是它！”

罗兰看着箱子，看到一只手放在了箱子上的密码锁上，而这只手的主人想用另一只手取出这只药剂，但是后脑处宛如被利爪切开的伤口，让他已经没有行动能力了。

罗兰没有任何犹豫，直接一把抓住了这支药剂，然后将其放进了药剂腰带中。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Roland has been cleaning the road to Huayuan Community in the past few days.

There are obviously far fewer zombies on this road than elsewhere.

Roland was lightly dressed, carrying only a knife and two guns. He was wearing leather armor and swimming goggles on his head, but the goggles were not worn over his eyes.

He sneaked all the way, trying not to disturb the zombies around him.

Even if a zombie discovered Roland, he would be quickly dealt with without attracting more zombies.

At about noon, Roland finished walking this kilometer and arrived near the gate of the Garden Community.

"Sure enough, Lingling didn't lie to me."

Roland looked at the gate of the garden community and nodded secretly in his heart.

Outside the gate of the community, there were many traces left after the battle, as well as an armored vehicle. However, at this moment, the armored vehicle was full of dents and scratches and looked dilapidated.

"The thing is inside!"

Roland stared at the armored vehicle and then carefully observed the surroundings.

Around the armored vehicle, some zombies were wandering, and there were many corpses of zombies on the ground, obviously left over from previous battles.

There are even some elite zombies that look like they are no ordinary zombies!

"If these zombies have crystal nuclei in their brains..."

Roland felt hot in his heart, and then he suppressed the urge to open the blind box immediately and looked around with vigilant eyes.

"Nothing unusual was found. Maybe the zombie is not here, or it was killed."

After observing for a long time, Roland's eyes narrowed: "Quick victory!"

He put the long knife behind his back, hung a gun on his belt, held the gun in both hands, and suddenly rushed towards the armored vehicle at full speed.

Although there seems to be no danger, there have been high-intensity battles here. In order to safely obtain the potion that can remove the zombie virus, Roland will naturally not hold back!

With his current strength, holding an automatic rifle in his hand, he can completely crush him without an automatic rifle!

Roland was seen to be very fast. After a dozen steps, he rushed to the armored body.

The door of the armored vehicle was drilled in.

There are no zombies inside, just corpses.

And in one and a half.

"That's it!"

Roland looked at the box and saw a hand placed on the combination lock on the box. The owner of this hand wanted to take out the potion with the other hand, but the wound on the back of his head was like a wound cut by sharp claws, leaving him unable to move.

Without any hesitation, Roland grabbed the potion and put it into his potion belt.
